title: Whitening Inverts the Hierarchy: What the Norm of a Whitened Embedding Measures
abstract: arXiv:2609.23117v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Whitening a foundation-model embedding and using its squared norm as a training-free likelihood surrogate is motivated by the observation that whitened coordinates often appear approximately standard normal. We show that this observation follows from the projection central limit theorem and therefore does not imply a Gaussian joint distribution. Across multiple encoders and three training objectives, we find systematic over-dispersion of the whitened radius relative to the Gaussian reference, including against distributional clones with identical mean and covariance. We further show that the commonly reported agreement between empirical and theoretical norm statistics is an algebraic consequence of in-sample whitening and does not constitute evidence for Gaussianity.   We identify the mechanism behind this behavior: whitening reverses the encoder's spectral hierarchy, shifting the contribution to the squared norm toward near-degenerate d

translated_title: 白化反转了层级结构：白化嵌入的范数究竟度量了什么
translated_abstract: 对基础模型嵌入进行白化，并将其平方范数用作免训练的似然代理，其动机在于观察到白化后的坐标通常近似呈现标准正态分布。我们证明这一观察源于投影中心极限定理，因此并不意味着联合分布服从高斯分布。在多个编码器和三种训练目标下，我们发现白化半径相对于高斯参考存在系统性的过度离散，即使与具有相同均值和协方差的分布克隆相比也是如此。我们进一步表明，通常报告的经验范数统计量与理论范数统计量之间的一致性，是样本内白化的代数结果，并不构成高斯性的证据。我们识别出这一行为背后的机制：白化反转了编码器的谱层级结构，使对平方范数的贡献转向近乎退化的维度（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文揭示了白化嵌入范数并非高斯性的证据——白化会反转编码器的谱层级，使范数主要由近乎退化的维度贡献，因此其平方范数作为免训练似然代理的理论依据并不成立。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that whitening inverts the encoder's spectral hierarchy, shifting the squared-norm contribution toward near-degenerate dimensions, so the apparent coordinate normality and norm-statistics agreement are not evidence of Gaussianity for using whitened norm as a training-free likelihood surrogate.
